local _0I1l=109821
local _0l0O=53400
local _lIll={}
local _OOO0={}
do local i,p,plen=0,1,#_11II while p<=plen do i=i+1 local c1,c2=_11II:sub(p,p),_11II:sub(p+1,p+1) _lIll[i]=_1I00(_OII0[c1].._OII0[c2],36) p=p+2 end end
local OPFN={
  [48]=function(b,k) local x=b for j=1,(k%4)+1 do x=(x+j)%256 end return x end,
  [190]=function(b,k) k=k%8 if k==0 then return b end local lo=b%(2^k) local hi=math.floor(b/(2^k)) return (lo*(2^(8-k))+hi)%256 end,
  [233]=function(b) return ((b%16)*16)+math.floor(b/16) end,
  [42]=function(b,k) return ((b-k)*2)%256 end,
  [192]=function(b) return 255-b end,
  [169]=function(b,k) return (b-k+256)%256 end,
  [198]=function(b,k) local x=b for j=1,(k%4)+1 do x=(x+j)%256 end return x end,
  [108]=function(b,k) local r,p,a,c=0,1,b,k while a>0 or c>0 do local ab,cb=a%2,c%2 if ab~=cb then r=r+p end a=(a-ab)/2 c=(c-cb)/2 p=p*2 end return r end
}
local SEQ={233}
local CN=1
local i,n=1,#_lIll
while i<=n do
  local keys={}
  for c=1,CN do keys[c]=_lIll[i] i=i+1 end
  local val=_lIll[i] i=i+1
  for c=CN,1,-1 do val=OPFN[SEQ[c]](val,keys[c]) end
  _OOO0[#_OOO0+1]=_IIII(val)
end
local __src=_llll(_OOO0)
local __cs=0
for k=1,#__src do __cs=(__cs*131+string.byte(__src,k))%65536 end
if #__src~=_0I1l or __cs~=_0l0O then error("MEEN HUB VM: integrity check failed (len "..#__src.."/".._0I1l..", checksum "..__cs.."/".._0l0O..")") end
local __f,__ferr
if load then __f,__ferr=load(__src) end
if not __f and loadstring then __f,__ferr=loadstring(__src) end
if not __f then error("MEEN HUB VM: decoded chunk failed to compile -> "..tostring(__ferr)) end
-- MEMORY HYGIENE: drop every reference to the plaintext decoded source and
-- the raw instruction buffers now that it's compiled, then nudge the
-- collector, so a memory scanner that runs AFTER this point has nothing
-- left to find. (Can't do anything about a debugger already attached
-- before this line ran -- nothing running inside the sandbox can.)
_11II,_lIll,_OOO0,__src=nil,nil,nil,nil
if collectgarbage then pcall(collectgarbage,"collect") end
return __f()
